title: AI-Powered Agricultural Contact Center for Farmers
summary: POTRAZ describes pilots in three wards using voice and SMS agricultural advice. Income, loss-reduction, and adoption figures are projections.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: POTRAZ describes pilots in three wards using voice and SMS agricultural advice. Development continues, and income, loss-reduction, and adoption figures are projections.
purpose: Give farmers localized advice through basic phones and local languages.
location: Mashonaland West and Masvingo provinces, Zimbabwe
